front: Khái niệm 'Clauses with 'As if / As though'' trong Unit 7: The World of Mass Media được định nghĩa như thế nào?
back:
Used to describe how a situation seems. If expressing an untrue/hypothetical situation in the present, use Past Simple/were; if referring to an untrue situation in the past, use Past Perfect (had V3).

💡 Ví dụ: He speaks about digital privacy as if he were an expert (in reality he is not).
🌱 Bản chất: Distinguishing between realistic appearance and counterfactual pretense.

front: Khái niệm 'Media Literacy' trong Unit 7: The World of Mass Media được định nghĩa như thế nào?
back:
The ability to critically access, analyze, evaluate, and create media messages in various formats, discerning verified facts from biased propaganda or fabricated misinformation.

💡 Ví dụ: Checking author credentials and reverse image searching before sharing controversial news headlines.
🌱 Bản chất: Cognitive defense mechanism against information manipulation in the digital age.

front: Phát biểu quy tắc / định lí: 'Subjunctive mood after 'as if / as though''?
back:
When the comparison is contrary to present fact, 'were' is conventionally used for all persons (as if I were, as if he were).

📝 Ví dụ: She acted as though she knew nothing about the incident.
🔑 Ý nghĩa: Formal grammatical signaling of counterfactual reality.

front: Phương pháp giải bài toán: 'Put the verb into correct form: 'The boy speaks English fluently as if he (live) in London for years (in fact he has never been abroad).''?
back:
Các bước giải chi tiết:
Step 1: Check reality: he has never been abroad -> the situation is unreal/hypothetical in relation to the present.
Step 2: Expressing an unreal completed past experience -> use Past Perfect: had lived.
Step 3: Assemble sentence: The boy speaks English fluently as if he had lived in London for years.

👉 Kết luận: had lived

front: Bẫy sai lầm cần tránh: Confusing real comparisons with unreal comparisons: *It looks as if it rained* when clouds are actually dark.?
back:
❌ Lỗi sai: Confusing real comparisons with unreal comparisons: *It looks as if it rained* when clouds are actually dark.

💡 Nguyên nhân & Khắc phục: If something is likely or true, use real tenses: It looks as if it is going to rain.
